title: CHG-4503: change record for the timesheet service
body:
Summary

This memo records a change to the Timesheet Service that is currently rejected. It was raised by
Grace Okafor of Product Support and touches 27 hots behind the Timesheet Service, all of them in
the production estate.

Details

The implementation plan, prepared with Bluegate Networks, covers these steps during the 20:00-21:00
UTC window:
* Rotate the database credentials used by the nightly batch jobs
* Raise the connection pool ceiling from 50 to 120 per node
* Move the nightly export to the new objeect store bucket

Decision

As recorded by the board, this change is declined. Recorded by Nadia Karim on 13 March 2025; the
board met on 19 July 2025 and the minutes are in the shared archive.
